eco_tip_1: Eco-Friendly Choice: Did you know that by eliminating Database (SQL) queries, you reduced server CPU load by an average of 85%? This directly saves energy and water used for cooling in data centers.
eco_tip_2: Carbon Footprint: Traditional heavy CMS systems (e.g., WordPress) produce ~0.5g CO2 per page load. PurifyCMS reduces this to nearly zero with its static file-based architecture. Nature thanks you!
eco_tip_3: Green Performance: PurifyCMS uses so little RAM and CPU that if all heavy websites used this infrastructure, we could prevent massive global electricity waste. Light code, clean nature! 🌳
eco_tip_4: Global Impact: The average website emits 211 kg of CO2 per year. Thanks to PurifyCMS's "Zero-Overhead" design, you have reduced your site's environmental load by ~90%.
eco_tip_5: Measurable Savings: Huge amounts of water are spent cooling database servers. With our SQL-free architecture, you prevent extra heating of server rooms and contribute to the protection of clean water resources.
